overview.description: The GMO Power Infrastructure ETF (KWH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund targets the power infrastructure industry, incorporating global economic trends, commodity prices, and governmental policies in its investment decisions. It is actively managed and seeks total return. KWH was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by GMO.

data.title: GMO Launches GMO Power Infrastructure ETF (KWH)
data.text: BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--GMO launches GMO Power Infrastructure ETF (KWH), designed to provide exposure to long-term structural investment tailwind.

news.t: GMO Launches GMO Power Infrastructure ETF (KWH)

holdings.infoBox: KWH is an equity ETF with a total of 79 individual holdings. The top holdings are Schneider Electric S.E. stock at 5.14%, Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 4.68%, Eaton Corporation at 3.43%, Trane Technologies at 2.69%, and Enel SpA at 2.52%.
